component.name: AlienFX
component.summary: Control the lights of an Alienware M14x

description.p: Set the colors of the keyboard zones, touchpad, media bar, speakers and logo of an Alienware M14x laptop, with a live preview of the laptop.

ul.li: Colors shown exactly as the hardware renders them
Presets and your own saved profiles, shared with the alienfx-cli command
Power button styles for each power state: plugged in, charging, on battery, battery critical
